title: WFL WEEKLY 5 - Week 16: The Final Four
body:
And just like that there were 4. The semi-final round of the WFL Playoffs have been home to some of the most iconic matchups in WFL History. Who can forget when Fabian was seemingly certain to be into the WFL Championship, and Brock Purdy & Deebo Samuel completely crumbled to improbably send Ale to a champion game that he would eventually win. Are we in for an another cinematic weekend here? Jonah vs Parker is an absolute clash of this season’s titans and should be a high scoring affair. Drew vs Andy is the division rival rubber match between two former commissioners who have certainly been outspoken this season. With a seemingly high scoring week ahead, who will win the race and book their place, sending their face to the championship?   
  
Without further ado, let’s rock n roll  
  
## Biggest Winner:  
Fans of A New WFL Champion - With the victories of On the Cock and Wabi Sabi, we are guaranteed to have a brand new WFL Champion. One of either Jonah, Drew, Parker or Andy will be able to call themselves a league winner for the first time in their fantasy football history. Betting odds would tell you On the Cock and Parker are the favorites, but as we’ve seen all season, all it takes is one weird week for anything to be possible. Cinderella stories tend to do well in the WFL, and there certainly isn’t a bigger one than Wabi Sabi and Andy. Can he give himself one more shot at the gold?  
  
  
## Biggest Loser:  
The Old Guard of the WFL Champions Club - Welp. The dreams of keeping the WFL Champions Club a 3 person only died very quickly as Marvin’s Room got extreme home makeovered by On the Cock, and I ❤️ Ohio suffered heartbreak at the hands of the team they let into the playoffs, Wabi Sabi. Good news for Jack & Ale, rumor has it that their game is actually glitched on the app and is actually a semi-final game as well.  Commish make the playoffs double elimination, no balls.

## The Case 4 The Final Four:  
We asked the Final Four competitors in the WFL Playoffs that after the tragedies and triumphs, the ups and downs, why should fans and other GMs believe that their team has what it takes to hoist the WFL Championship trophy. THIS is what they told us:  
  
Parker: "I boast one of the strongest cores of any talent in the top 4. Puka, Bijan, Achane, Maye all can go off on their own rights. I think we have a great group of 4 teams in their own rights as well. We got a good one this weekend"  
  
Jonah: "We at Waker and Baker Co. are leading a crusade to rid the once-sacred WFL of managers who purchased multiple first round picks and threw off the universal balance of the league’s chakras. It’s not about how good your team is or what players you have. It’s about whether your spirit is at peace with the Makers, and moving in accordance with the flow of their will. I believe that Wake and Baker Co. is championing the will of the Maker and will restore balance to the league."  
  
Andy: "My team had a rough second half of the season but we came into the playoffs prepared with a statement win. I like the doubt that people have with my team if you’re not with us you’re against us and I want them to stay on that side. I think we have a good team over here that was trying to figure out how to play together after an injury riddled first half."  
  
Drew: "I’m playing with a chip on my shoulder. Everyone is counting us out given our missing players, but this is a TEAM. We are stronger than the sum of our parts and I expect us to continue the success we’ve seen in the regular season. Andy is a formidable opponent (we’ve split the season series) so I expect a tough matchup, but the heart I’ve seen from my players this season for their fallen captain should vault us over anyone who stands in our way"  
  
  
## Papa’s Picks:  
  
**WFL Weekly Game of the Week: **On the Cock (Parker) vs. Wake and Baker Co. (Jonah)  
- It’s a matchup that many pegged as a potential championship showdown, but we get it one week early. Parker and Jonah were picked by many WFL GMs as their eventual league winner, and the victor has the opportunity to fulfill that destiny. Will Jonah FINALLY take a step towards greatness after many seasons of seemingly falling just short? Or will the new Commissioner start knocking on the doorstep of taking absolute control of the WFL? Last matchup between these two could not have finished any closer, are we in for more fireworks? There’s only one way to find out.
